note: Who accredits, certifies or lists a hospital. A recognition is counted once per recognizer per facility. The count is a fact about who has inspected and who has paid to be inspected; it is not this project's ranking, and nothing here says an accredited hospital is a better hospital. Most of these schemes are voluntary and the applicant pays the fee.

entries.label: Joint Commission International
entries.what: accreditation of hospitals, clinics and programmes outside the United States; three-year cycle

entries.label: ISQua External Evaluation Association
entries.what: accredits the accreditors — a standard for the bodies that run the schemes

entries.label: Temos International Healthcare Accreditation
entries.what: accreditation aimed squarely at facilities treating international patients

entries.label: Global Healthcare Accreditation
entries.what: certification of the medical-travel care pathway rather than the clinical unit

entries.label: Accreditation Association for Ambulatory Health Care International / AACI
entries.what: international clinic and centre accreditation

entries.label: DNV Healthcare
entries.what: hospital accreditation built on ISO 9001

entries.label: Australian Council on Healthcare Standards International
entries.what: the Australian scheme, run abroad

entries.label: QHA Trent Accreditation
entries.what: a UK-based international hospital scheme

entries.label: NABH (India)
entries.what: the National Accreditation Board for Hospitals and Healthcare Providers, and its own international arm

entries.label: CBAHI (Saudi Arabia)
entries.what: the Saudi Central Board for Accreditation of Healthcare Institutions; mandatory at home

entries.label: Healthcare Accreditation Institute (Thailand)
entries.what: the Thai HA standard, run by a public organisation

entries.label: KOIHA / KAHF (South Korea)
entries.what: Korean accreditation of institutions serving foreign patients, alongside the MOHW registration that is compulsory there

entries.label: Malaysia Healthcare Travel Council
entries.what: a government agency that lists and promotes member hospitals

entries.label: PROMED (Costa Rica)
entries.what: the national council that certifies providers for international patients

entries.label: Türkiye Ministry of Health health-tourism authorisation
entries.what: the certificate a Turkish facility must hold to treat international patients lawfully

entries.label: UAE health regulators (DHA, DoH, MOHAP)
entries.what: the emirate-level licences a clinic operates under

entries.label: Care Quality Commission (England)
entries.what: the English regulator; its ratings are public and per-location

entries.label: Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority (UK)
entries.what: licenses every UK fertility clinic and publishes each one's results

entries.label: SART / CDC ART reporting (United States)
entries.what: clinic-by-clinic fertility outcomes, reported under federal law

entries.label: Newsweek / Statista World's Best Hospitals
entries.what: an annual ranking by survey and published indicators

entries.label: Somebody else
entries.what: a named body that fits none of the above; the record says who in its note
